steps.en: Install the CLI and start it in your project folder
steps.zh: 装上 CLI，在项目目录里启动

steps.en: Choose Letta Cloud or local state, then connect your model keys
steps.zh: 选 Letta Cloud 还是本地存状态，再连上模型 key

steps.en: Ask it to study the repo and bootstrap its memory
steps.zh: 让它读一遍仓库，初始化记忆

steps.en: Saves what it learned as git-versioned memory files pinned into its own prompt
steps.zh: 把学到的东西存成用 git 记版本的记忆文件，钉进自己的提示词

steps.en: Give it coding tasks, and correct it when it gets your conventions wrong
steps.zh: 派编码任务给它，它弄错你的约定时纠正它

steps.en: Does the work with file, shell and git tools, and commits the lesson to memory
steps.zh: 用文件、shell、git 工具把活干完，把教训提交进记忆

steps.en: Next session, in the terminal, desktop app or a chat channel, the same agent resumes with that memory
steps.zh: 下次会话，无论终端、桌面端还是聊天渠道，同一个 agent 带着记忆接着干

value.en: You stop re-explaining your repo and habits every session: one agent remembers them, in files you can diff
value.zh: 你不用每次开会话都重新交代仓库和习惯：同一个 agent 记得它们，而且记在你能 diff 的文件里

sources: README.md, Get started (npm install -g @letta-ai/letta-code; navigate to your project directory and run letta; Letta Cloud is the default, first launch asks to sign in or proceed locally; letta backend cloud / letta backend local; /connect configures your own LLM API keys)
README.md, Feature Overview (memory blocks, skill learning, /sleeptime dreaming, MemFS tracks all context via git, CLI / desktop app / chat.letta.com / Telegram / Slack / Discord channels)

docs.letta.com/configuration/memory (2026-10-09: /init bootstraps memory for the current project by inspecting the repository; /remember always use pnpm in this repo; the agent commits the update to MemFS; dreaming uses background subagents)
docs.letta.com/platform/cli (2026-10-09: cd your-project; letta; ask the agent to explore your codebase or run /init)
src/tools/descriptions/ (Bash, Edit, ApplyPatch, Read, Grep, Glob, EnterWorktree, WatchPR, Memory tool definitions)
